'''2012 European Championship Emil Wallin LS We'll Handle This''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Emil Wallin]] at [[2012 European Championship]] (European Championship).


== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[We'll Handle This / Duel Of The Fates]]
* '''Username:''' Darth_Link
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' European Championship
